endorsements.name: Matt Florell
endorsements.label: CVE-2022-34876
endorsements.description: SQL Injection vulnerability in admin interface (/vicidial/admin.php) of VICIdial via modify_email_accounts, access_recordings, and agentcall_email parameters allows attacker to spoof identity, tamper with existing data, allow the complete disclosure of all data on the system, destroy the data or make it otherwise unavailable, and become administrators of the database server. This issue affects: VICIdial 2.14b0.5 versions prior to 3555.
endorsements.subtitle: CVE · Severity: MEDIUM (CVSS 3.1, 5.5)

povs-taxonomy.explanation: The CVE endorsement credits this individual with a reviewed vulnerability finding.
